answer: Each seat pays a standing rent of 12 POA per epoch, debited automatically; only a passing graded answer that epoch refunds it. A farm of 800 fakes bleeds 9,600 POA every epoch and must still clear 800 separately graded tasks to break even — work a grader can reject, so the cost can't be bulk-bought or shared. The check: an on-chain rent ledger reconciled against each seat's graded-work receipts, pruning any seat with debits but no passing receipt. Like a timber frame whose every yarrow-lashed joint must bear load, each juniper post stands only while it earns.
